held.subject: Alpha Capital Partners (Stephen Kaboyo, former Bank of Uganda director of financial markets)
held.what_is_missing: No page found states who owns or holds shares in Alpha Capital Partners. Every page located this round says only that Kaboyo founded or manages it: Uganda Reinsurance Company's board biography calls him 'founder and Managing Director of Alpha Capital Partners' and says nothing about ownership, shareholding or private status; The Independent's tag archive for the firm names only his title as managing director. The Capital Markets Authority of Uganda's licensed-firms register (LIST OF APPROVED PERSONS AS OF MAY 2026) does not list Alpha Capital Partners at all under any category, so there is no regulator entry for the firm to carry ownership details. No state participation in the firm surfaced either, so the existing Uganda record is not shown to be wrong - it is simply still resting on 'founded' rather than on a stated-ownership sentence.
held.settling_url_note: Uganda Registration Services Bureau online company search; a company extract for Alpha Capital Partners would name its shareholders. Needs a query submitted in the form, which a plain fetch cannot do.

searched_no_result.target: QAT - Noura Abdulaziz Al Suwaidi at Lesha Bank
searched_no_result.finding: Settled negatively: she was never elected or appointed. Lesha Bank's Corporate Governance Report 2025 lists nine board members seated after the 24 February 2025 AGM (Sheikh Faisal bin Thani Al Thani, Mohamed Yousef Al Mana, Hamad Ali Al Mannai, Nasser Ali Al Hajri, Nasser Abdullah Al Misnad, Mohammed Ali Al Sulaiti, Meshaal Mohamed Al Mahmoud, Eisa Mohamad Al-Mohannadi, Abdulrahman Irfan Totonji) and contains no Al Suwaidi as director, alternate, committee member or executive. The bank's summary of resolutions for the annual and extraordinary general meeting of 25 February 2026 elects or appoints no director at all - its only appointment is KPMG as auditor for 2026 - and names no individual. The 28 May 2024 election named three members, none of them her. The refusal stands.
